```sql
with paid_orders as (
    select o.order_id
    from orders o
    join showrooms s on s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
    where not o.is_test
      and o.status = 'paid'
      and s.country_code = 'GB'
      and o.business_date between date '2026-08-01' and date '2026-08-31'
),
attempts_per_order as (
    select po.order_id,
           count(a.attempt_id) as attempt_count
    from paid_orders po
    left join payment_attempts a
      on a.order_id = po.order_id
     and not a.is_test
    group by po.order_id
)
select null as key,
       cast(avg(attempt_count) as decimal(38,12)) as value
from attempts_per_order
order by value
```
